title: the same two profiles with -Profile Alpha: the answer comes back
titleZh: 同样两个 profile,加上 -Profile Alpha:答案回来了
why: The pair of this case and fault-trustedhosts-multi-profile is what proves -Profile actually resolves the ambiguity instead of being decoration. It also pins that the app-level and package-level patch layers stay in the chain while only the profile layer is narrowed (narrowing everything once turned a real blocked finding into unknown).
inject: the same temp DSH_HOME with profiles Alpha and Beta, this time with -Profile Alpha
